objective: Review the definition-only direct native-Verilator command-path boundary after the accepted scoped sidecar execution run, accept the narrow boundary, and select the next non-executing fixture without claiming native option support, direct command execution, timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, or raw full-state equality.

review_decision.reason: The definition keeps the direct-looking Verilator command path small enough to review: native parser values may preserve ordinary build inputs and shape options, but they must materialize or reference the reviewed sidecar stage plan before any execution authority exists.
review_decision.weakest_point: A direct-looking command remains easy to over-read as implemented native Verilator option support. This review therefore accepts only the boundary definition and advances to a non-executing fixture; it still does not execute Verilator, run RTL, compare outputs, measure timing, infer arbitrary source closure or filelist dependencies, allocate GPU work automatically, change runtime/ABI, or prove raw full-state equality.
accepted_because: the minimum spelling stays expanded as --sim-accel sidecar-gpu plus explicit positive state and step counts
the compact --sim-accel-shape spelling remains wrapper compatibility rather than the native minimum
parser-owned fields preserve ordinary Verilator inputs without becoming source-closure authority
sidecar-owned fields retain source closure, coverage target, host-probe metadata, state/report paths, stage order, and generated evidence policy
dry-run or preflight remains required before any later direct command execution
coverage_output_equivalence remains a later compare policy rather than evidence from this review

accepted_boundary.direct_command_route: native parser values must materialize or reference a structured sidecar stage plan before any execution authority
accepted_boundary.wrapper_invocation_status: compatibility evidence and implementation fallback, not proof of native direct command support
accepted_boundary.intermediate_operator_plan_status: reviewable metadata only; command_argv is not runtime authority by itself
accepted_boundary.coverage_policy_status: later compare policy only, not evidence from this review gate

accepted_parser_sidecar_split.generated_evidence_policy: reports/ and artifacts/ are generated evidence only and never source of truth
accepted_parser_sidecar_split.source_closure_policy: parser-preserved source_files and filelists are build inputs only until a reviewed sidecar source boundary resolves closure

selected_next_workstream.reason: After accepting the boundary, the next smallest proof is a fixture contract that pins the helper/module/test scope before implementation, because the direct-looking command path can otherwise be over-read as implemented native Verilator support.

not coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow
